package.name: wojtek_mujoco_hardware_interface
package.description:
MuJoCo behind ros2_control: the simulated plant for wojtek, exporting the same interfaces the MD80 and IMU drivers export on the robot. Lets the real bringup (controller_manager, the broadcasters, real_io_node, policy_node) run unchanged over simulated physics, so arming, zeroing and the ramps are exercised on the desk. PC-side only; never deployed.
MuJoCo itself comes from the pip wheel (see CMakeLists), the same dependency the sim tooling and training already have.
